texts.zh:
[killer_fleet.GetName]报告称，[killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName]星系的海盗私掠船已经被摧毁了。虽然附近恒星系中还有一些零零散散的海盗船，但从目前来看，星际海盗已经成为了过去……至少今天如此。

我们从他们丰厚的储存室里设法缴获了一批来历不明的赃物，这批宝藏我们可以纳入国库，另有他用。
texts.en:
The [killer_fleet.GetName] reports that the timeworn pirate galleons in the [killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName] system have been destroyed. Save for any stragglers in nearby systems, galactic piracy is a thing of the past... For now.

We were able to recover a considerable hoard of ill-gained loot from their strong room, a treasure which we promptly relocated to our own coffers.

texts.zh:
[killer_fleet.GetName]报告称，[killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName]星系中的破旧海盗船已被摧毁。不考虑邻近星系那些游民的话，星际海盗活动算是成为过去式了……至少就现在而言。

我们能从他们坚固的舱室中收回堆积满满的赃物了，其中包括一张古代数据板——令我们惊讶的是，它似乎能为神秘L-星门的运作方式提供崭新的见解。
texts.en:
The [killer_fleet.GetName] reports that the timeworn pirate galleons in the [killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName] system have been destroyed. Save for any stragglers in nearby systems, galactic piracy is a thing of the past... For now.

We were able to recover a considerable hoard of ill-gained loot from their strong room, including an ancient datapad which, startlingly, seems to offer fresh insights into how the mysterious L-Gates function.
